nalli:15489265238315.description: Geetanjali unfolds in Banarasi silk, where floral motifs create a gentle rhythm across the weave. A broad contrast border is topped with symmetrical florals detailed in fine silver zari Meenakari, culminating in a Konia buta that flows into the pallu. The body carries a larger floral buta with delicate Meenakari, while a heavy twill pallu completes the saree.

nalli:15421220684075.description: Geetanjali unfolds in Banarasi silk, where floral motifs create a gentle rhythm across the weave. A broad contrast border is topped with symmetrical florals detailed in fine silver zari Meenakari, culminating in a Konia buta that flows into the pallu. The body carries a larger floral buta with delicate Meenakari, while a heavy twill pallu completes the saree.

nalli:15421220946219.description: Maithreyi unfolds in Banarasi silk, with a delicate floral vine flowing diagonally across the body, interspersed with floral buttas. Finely woven borders complement the pattern, while a floral creeper Jaal with green Meena adds depth. The pallu features botanical floral motifs, each unit individually woven with multiple tilis creating the intricate green Meena detailing.

nalli:15421220847915.description: Shobhana unfolds in Banarasi satin, inspired by the intricate beauty of traditional Indian jewellery. A statement floral border brings smaller blooms into a flowing Bel, echoed in a diagonal arrangement across the pallu. Traditional Banarasi twill frames the design, while the blouse piece continues the floral language through a coordinating brocade. Shobhana brings jewellery to the language of the weave.

nalli:15421220618539.description: Indrani unfolds in Banarasi silk, where delicate floral buttas and stylised Mor motifs create a distinctive rhythm. Inspired by a rare archival motif, the elongated Mor feather adds a unique character. Bel-Boora zari bands frame the saree, while vertical zari stripes and textured panels enrich the pallu. Woven in Varanasi, Indrani celebrates the richness of Banarasi craft.

nalli:15421221044523.description: Mayurika unfolds in Banarasi silk, where a delicately woven peacock border takes centre stage, flowing into the pallu. Woven in the Kadhwa technique, Alfi brings gold and silver zari together, while fine Meenakari details the peacock's feathers. A bold gold twill frames the motif, while small floral buttas across the body let the peacock remain the focal point.
